subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT the United Nations' legal instrument for protection of climate system?

options.text: United Nations Framework Convention On Climate Change
United Nations International Panel on Climate Change

solution:
The correct answer is __**United Nations International Panel on Climate Change**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **United Nations International Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) is not a legal instrument for protecting the climate system**.
 
• Instead,** it is an independent body that provides scientific advice on climate change**
 
• The predecessor** of the IPCC was the Advisory Group on Greenhouse Gases (AGGG)**
 
• Three **organizations set up the AGGG in 1986**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC)**

 
 
• A treaty that establishes the legal framework for international cooperation on climate change.
 
• The UNFCCC's goal is to limit dangerous human interference with the climate system. 
 
 
 
• **Kyoto Protocol**
 
 
• An international treaty that aims to reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
 
• The Kyoto Protocol called for industrialized nations to reduce their carbon dioxide emissions.
